coverage: Record actual observed boundaries; early EOS or interrupted cases remain explicitly unobserved. No invented coverage.
referenceDisposition: Candidate-specific independent selected-boundary evidence only. No activation or substitution of old Qwen3.5 numerical fixtures; historical .001 gates remain unchanged.
